sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चत्वारिंशः सर्गः ।। ४० ।।
transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmaduttarakāṇḍe catvāriṁśaḥ sargaḥ ।। 40 ।।

translations.english: Thus ends the fortieth canto of the Uttara Kanda in the Ramayana, the first poem, composed by the sage Valmiki.
